page.layout: One page of text. Running head at the top, with the page number at the top right. Below it, two coin engravings side by side. Below them, two paragraphs of running text in one column. A decorative ornament (fleuron) at the foot. No marginal notes.

main_text.l: VENCESLAVS succedit Carolo patri Imperatori hu-
ius nominis quarto, imperatq; post eum anno mundi 5340. à
Christo nato 1378. hic nec patri, nec avo similis fuit: cum pa-
tre tamen annos 8. regnarat: tandem solus ignauissimè rem ad-
ministrat annis 22. Cæterum à Sigismundo fratre captus est,
móxque Electores ei imperium abrogant, in cuius locum Ro-
bertum Bauarum sufficiunt. Porrò Galeatius Vicecomes Me-
diolanensis bonam Italiæ partem suo dominio adiicit, atque à
Venceslao, pro Vicecomite, Dux Mediolanensis dicitur. tunc
igitur in Ducatum erectus est primùm Vicecomitatus Medio-
lanensis. Apud fratrem in carcere apoplexia obiit Venceslaus.
Blond.lib.io.[?]deca.2.Egna.lib.3.
ROBERTVS, qui & Rupertus, Bauariæ Dux, deiecto
Venceslao, imperat anno mundi 5362. à Christo nato 1400.
Hic ut Florentinis gratum faceret, ad comprimendam Galeatij
potentiam, in Italiam traiicit: verùm cum eo ad Benacum con-
gressus, facilè repellitur: unde mox ad Venetos deflexit: & in-
cassum Florentinis adnitecibus[?] ne Italia exiret, in Germaniam
retro abiit, paci, religionique vacaturus, Florentinos interim in
magno relinquens discrimine. Obiit post annos ex quo impe-
rauit decem. Vide ut supra.

page.notes: Two engraved coin medallions at the top, not text. Left coin: laureate head facing left, legend "IMP. VENCESLAVS AVG." Right coin: head facing right with a crown or diadem, legend "IMP. RVPERTVS" with "P.F. AVG." on the left. The legends are copied as engraved. Doubtful readings: "io" in "Blond.lib.io" (perhaps 10) and "adnitecibus" are marked [?]. The printed "hu ius" is a line-end split of "huius" without a hyphen, and is written whole. Spelling of u/v and i/j is normalised as instructed (ut, unde, Vide); other spellings are as printed.
